author: Stuarts
body:
About me

- 18 years of age
- My Discord is: Stuart [Drengia]#4374

My activity will be rather profuse as I intend to be online as much as possible.
Mind you that I am in a GMT+1 zone , however communication issues won't be a problem.
I will also contribute to the team however I can regardless If I'm home or not, I am still accessible through
the discord app.

I am an experienced builder as I have been a highly ranked builder for several Pixelmon servers, theses servers are

- ImpactMC (down)
- InitiaNova

On theses servers I was head-builder in charge of building their pokémon gyms , pokémon leagues, spawns , hubs and managing weekly projects that kept the server interesting for players. (projects such as Victory roads, pokémon temples, hidden caves, casinos,mazes)
My experience on theses servers lasted around 3 years (but I still am in relations with InitiaNova in case they need a Builder) and thus
helped me get comfortable in WorldEdit, VoxelSniper and McEdit.
Theses are the attributes that I think distinguish me from other applicants.

Skills

What I think is essential for someone to hone their map making skills in terms of gameplay
is for that person to understand overall how a DTM/CTF/CTW... map is made , what components define it to be
the way it is , the said person also needs to have experience in playing maps to be able to acknowledge what makes a map good
and fun .
What I find also essential is for the gameplay to be original and not a mere copy/paste of already existing maps, insparation is awesome
and can actually inspire to make really fun maps.
The last point that I think is essential is a minimum of esthetics, since no one likes playing an ugly map ...the map doesn't necessarily need to be the next Miss.Universe but it needs to be balanced and have a harmonious color scheme.

In terms of XML I am quite comfortable with it , I have a general understanding on how it works and what is what. And I am confident
in saying so. But in terms of finding errors , I am able to but I might not be the best at it.

I wouldn't mind both at all , but I'd much rather build maps , but if anyone needs an XML done and can't do it themselves , I am willing to take one for the team.

Past Experience

[DTM]Karnak I :   https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/bc7fb6c1e?page=1#reply383859
[CTW]Gyrus  :   https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/d21e3382f

Unfortunately theses are the only DTM/CTW/.... Maps that I have made so far as making this application.
But as I am writing this application I have a 3rd map in progress.

Self Reflection

Ever since I joined Avicus I admired the maps that were made and I aspired to one day be able to make maps like theses.
I have been a builder for as long as I've played Minecraft , but what really motivates me is the competitive side and being able
to make maps that would one day be in rotation.
I've always wanted to be a Builder for Avicus , but I am applying now as I find the time is right and that I have accumulated enough experience and skill in order to be considered.

I think I will help the team in a way where Avicus will be able to release maps weekly and keep players hyped for awesome new content,
I also aspire to help the team in anyway possible from team projects to solo projects.

Thank you for taking your time in reading my application, and I bid you good day :)


-Stuart
